headline: Can West Pharmaceutical Services (NYSE:WST) Continue To Grow Its Returns On Capital?
summary: To find a multi-bagger stock, what are the underlying trends we should look for in a business? Ideally, a business will show two trends; firstly a growing return on capital employed (ROCE) and secondly, an increasing amount of capital employed. This shows us that it's a compounding machine, able to continually reinvest its earnings back into the business and generate higher returns. So when we looked at West Pharmaceutical Services (NYSE:WST) and its trend of ROCE, we really liked what we saw.
